snippet.title: MORTALITY DECOMP. KILLERS: SHADOW OF ABADDON - Trailer
snippet.description:
“In the slums of Tokydon, ruthless crime-boss 'Abaddon' is caught in a gang war over selling immortality while he struggles with his own.”

MORTALITY DECOMP. KILLERS: SHADOW OF ABADDON is an expansion pack that expands on the story of the base game with an entire second campaign (at the same size as the first), featuring new gameplay mechanics, locations and characters. Play as the antagonist, Abaddon, who's crime syndicate is caught in a conflict over the Alxyte parasite.

Find out more or Wishlist the DLC at cuppakill.com
